subject.title: [codex] fix discord missing voice state handling

question: Should this PR wait for inspectable live Discord proof before merge, or may the assigned maintainer accept private proof for the voiceStatus behavior change?
rationale: The source and tests support the fix, but the changed behavior depends on Discord's live REST response and the current PR has no reviewer-inspectable proof artifact.

options.title: Require inspectable live proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Discord terminal output, logs, or a recording showing code 10065 returns absent while an unrelated error such as code 10004 still surfaces.

options.title: Accept maintainer-owned proof
options.body: A maintainer may decide private live validation is enough, but that should be stated visibly because the contributor-facing proof remains uninspectable.

options.title: Pause until proof exists
options.body: Keep the PR open without merging if no one can provide inspectable real Discord evidence for the changed action result.

recommendation.title: Require inspectable live proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Discord terminal output, logs, or a recording showing code 10065 returns absent while an unrelated error such as code 10004 still surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned, authored the current narrowing commit, and has the strongest recent history on the touched Discord REST and voice paths.
